rules: VERSATZ v1; 120 plies; threefold board+turn repetition; terminal own-turn gate check
method: Current release tactical/deep profiles opt in to exact1v1 continuation; other heuristic controls remain ordinary search. Seeded LCG for random players and hash tie breaks for search; four 180-degree symmetric deployments; each seed played with both initiative assignments. No random openings. Race/capture are competing evaluation policies. Automatic control is RANDOM ONLY with alternating predetermined directions; it does not establish stronger-policy balance.
limits: Paired rotated starts are correlated; effective sample size is smaller than game count.
Four formations and shallow searches do not solve the game.
No forced win within seven plies does not rule out longer forced openings.
Material advantage streak includes changes of leading side; it diagnoses persistent imbalance, not a causal advantage chain.

forcedOpening.scope: All legal moves, bounded horizon only. False means no forced win within that many plies.
